chunks: Ali ibn Unsur from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Abdullah ibn Bayser from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

A man came to the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) and said, 'O Messenger of Allah! I bear the greatest weight that men bear. Is it permissible for me to go to some of the beasts that belong to me, a she-camel or a donkey, for the women are not strong enough to bear what is with me?' The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said, 'Verily, Allah, Blessed and Exalted, did not create you until He created for you from your form that which can bear you.'

So the man left, and he did not delay long before he returned to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) and said to him the same as his words from the first time. So the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said to him, 'So where are you from the Black, the long-necked one?'

So the man left, and he did not delay long before he returned and said, 'O Messenger of Allah! I testify that you are truly the Messenger of Allah. I sought what you ordered me with, so I copulated with my own form from that which bears me, and that has sufficed me.'

key_terms.السَّوْدَاء: The Black (a specific woman known by this epithet)
key_terms.العَنَطْنَطَة: Long-necked (a description of a specific woman)
key_terms.يَحْتَمِلُنِي: That which can bear me (referring to physical capacity for intercourse)

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on a man with great strength having intercourse with animals according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi illustrates the principle of natural compatibility (fitrah) in marital relations, where the Prophet (peace be upon him) advises a man of exceptional strength to seek a partner whose physical constitution can naturally accommodate him, rather than forcing a mismatch. In Shia scholarly tradition, this narrative is often cited to emphasize that Allah’s creation is purposeful and balanced, serving as a practical guideline for marital harmony and a metaphor for spiritual compatibility. The resolution underscores the Islamic view that divine wisdom is embedded in physical form, making the 'black, sturdy' woman (al-Sawda’ al-Anatnata) a symbol of suitable endurance.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Salih Bin Abu Hammad, from Haroun Bin Muslim, from Bureyd Bin Muawiya, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘A man came over to the Prophet<sup>saww</sup>, so he said, ‘O Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>! I bear greater than what the men bear, so is it correct for me that I go to some of what is for me from the beasts, a she-camel or a donkey, for the women are not strong enough upon what is with me?’ Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Blessed and High did not Create you until He<sup>azwj</sup> Created for you from your shape, what can bear you’.

So the man left and it was not long before he returned to Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>, so he said to him similar to what his words were the first time. So Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said to him: ‘So where are you from the black (woman), the long-necked one and a healthy body?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said:

‘So the man left, and it was not long before he returned, so he said, ‘O Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>! I hereby testify that you<sup>saww</sup> are Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>, truly! I sought what you<sup>saww</sup> had ordered me with, so she happened to be upon my shape from what could bear me, and that has sufficed me’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Muhammad has narrated from Salih ibn abu Hammad from Harun ibn Muslim from Burayd ibn Mu‘awiyah who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that

once a man came to the Holy Prophet, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, and said, ‘O Messenger of Allah, I carry the largest thing that man carry, if I can make use of the animals that I own, like a donkey or she-camel, because women cannot bear what I have.’ The Messenger of Allah said, ‘Allah has not created your thing without creating what can match your kind.’

The man went and very shortly came back to the Messenger of Allah and repeated what he had said before. The Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, said, ‘Why do you not find the black woman with a tall neck and healthy body?’

He went and very shortly came back and said, ‘I testify that you are the Messenger of Allah in all truth. I searched for what you commanded me to do and found her to be of my kind and match and I am satisfied.’”
